command.mac: Probe c107 #2. Measure, do not fix. 1) Run `claude --version` and record it. 2) Clean up the first probe: run `git worktree list`; for each worktree on claude/modest-swanson-97fdbe or claude/nervous-panini-ef0139, run `git worktree remove <its path>`; then `git branch -D claude/modest-swanson-97fdbe claude/nervous-panini-ef0139`; record what each printed. 3) Run `git switch -c probe-c107b`, then `git commit --allow-empty -m "probe c107b"`, then `git switch -`, and record the new commit's short hash. 4) On this turn, which I typed, call start_session once with kind user_asked, title "probe c107 D", source branch probe-c107b, prompt "Run git branch --show-current and git log --oneline -1, reply with both, then stop." 5) Record: card yes/no (ask me in one line), started yes/no, branch reported, and whether its last commit is the hash from step 3. 6) Clean up: archive session D, remove its worktree with `git worktree remove`, delete its branch and probe-c107b with `git branch -D`. 7) Print one message for me to paste on the waiting page: the version, the cleanup lines, and the D line.
